author: Stahly
description:
Deep beneath the Mortal Realms, a new Duardin faction has been stirring. The Kromdron march out of their mountain strongholds with a brand-new model range and a Battletome that also takes the Fyreslayers under its wing. In this review of the Khazalite Holds army set, we unbox all 15 models, from the dwarf queen Hjulda Drakkblud and the Oathkeeper Cannon to the Clanshields and the monstrous Gholems. You’ll find high-res sprue images for every kit, a rundown of all build options, and a look inside the new Battletome, so you know exactly what you’re getting before the hold gates open.

The post Khazalite Holds army set unboxed: 15 new models and a Fyreslayers shake-up appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Khazalite Holds army set unboxed: 15 new models and a Fyreslayers shake-up
